title: The Manual Override That Didn't Respond

source.custody: Public retrieval pointer only; no source snapshot or independent custody.

original_proposition: Manual follow-up steering should respond after a change from autopilot.
rejected_assumption: Presence of manual steering proves effective manual override; challenged by reported nonresponse.
failure_mechanism: Reported lack of response to helm commands; physical root cause UNKNOWN.
failure_conditions: Second vessel incident on 2026-11-05 during transfer from autopilot to manual follow-up mode.
observed_consequence: ATSB reports steering wheel did not respond; alternative steering arrangements were used.
remaining_useful_information: Mode transfer and alternative steering are distinct paths; inspect actuation after override.
uncertainty: Investigation open; common cause across the two vessels not established.
counterevidence: Alternative steering reportedly remained available; this was not proof of total loss of control.
transfer_applications: Autonomous AI recovery; external stop; manual override; degraded mode.
transfer_limitations: Steering actuation differs from software authorization and irreversible commits; causal equivalence NOT TESTED.
reopening_conditions: Final ATSB findings, corrected sequence, verified cause or independent transfer test.

mechanisms.rationale: Manual follow-up did not respond according to ATSB.

title: The Brake That Actually Worked

source.custody: Public retrieval pointer only; no source snapshot or independent custody.

original_proposition: Independent detection and intervention may interrupt an unsafe transition.
rejected_assumption: A failed clearance boundary necessarily produces the immediate harmful consequence; bounded counterexample.
failure_mechanism: Runway incursion followed by successful alert, controller intervention and rejected takeoff.
failure_conditions: Vehicle entered active runway without clearance on 2026-02-17.
observed_consequence: ATSB reports the vehicle vacated and the flight crew rejected takeoff.
remaining_useful_information: Independent detection, communications and intervention can interrupt a consequence in a specific event.
uncertainty: Generalized stop effectiveness and all degraded conditions NOT TESTED.
counterevidence: This successful intervention is a positive control; it is not evidence of manual override failure.
transfer_applications: Autonomous AI recovery; external stop; independent intervention; consequence timing.
transfer_limitations: Aviation procedures and physical stopping distances do not establish software authority-path dominance.
reopening_conditions: New investigation evidence, counterexample or independent transfer evaluation.

mechanisms.rationale: Successful intervention contrasts with unsuccessful override; not a failed manual override.
